point_count_definition: Actual ground-filtered points with individual normal force>5N; not geometric flight
support_load_eligibility_gate: recorded point count>0 AND aggregate upward Fz>5N; diagnostic only
ground_force_definition: Measured ground-normal forces in N, not tangential friction force or evaluation mg normalization
friction_convention: Both robot and ground coefficients set0.7; not ground-only and no effective PhysX combine coefficient inferred
limitations: One seed/checkpoint/episode per independent policy; no causal/statistical or stable-contact guarantee. Inspect full-body video with contact and tracking.
Original grounded+0.4 is preserved. Added torque cost excludes wheels and is not a height/flight or zero-beta/yaw target.
Effective gains500/10 are explicit DC motor software PD, not native PhysX drive gains. Native measured applied actuator torque is in Nm.
Offline torque cost follows training's reset rule only at initial episode reset; it does not invent resets at reporting/control boundaries.
Torque cost and weighted-dt contribution are recomputed offline from recorded torques, not claimed as logged evaluator reward.
Zero thresholded count/load eligibility is not geometric separation or failure. Weak contacts<=5N cannot be recovered; engine force aggregation is specific.
HF diagnostics use original native200Hz states with linear detrend/Hann/Parseval, not a pose filter; intended yaw/sideslip and free absolute height remain.
Physical horizon6.98s exceeds reference6.96s; full tracking is unavailable without extrapolation and reference-overlap is separately labeled.
Checkpoint identity is metadata-bound if private weights are absent locally; remote owned parent independently verified their bytes.

camera.lookat: Same locked reference root position+[0,0,-.24] for both panels; hold last knot after6.96s

panel_titles.baseline: Baseline: no added leg torque-rate penalty

renderer_reward_labels.candidate_addition: leg applied-torque-rate penalty -0.05; not a contact reward replacement

rendering_limitations: Video50Hz subsamples native200Hz states; it cannot prove uninterrupted contact between frames.
Count is measured ground points above threshold. Zero count is not proof of flight; eligibility=count>0 AND upward Fz>5N.
Both independent policies retain original world poses and are not individually recentered if outside the common view.
Original contact +0.4 is retained; this is not the earlier failed ground-support-replacement policy.
Audited training/runtime/checkpoint provenance remains attached; replay alone does not certify improvement or causality.

notes: Official MJCF/STL assets are preserved; generated robot.xml changes only meshdir, names the floating root joint, and adds IK/display sites.
left/right_wheel sites are wheel hinge centers, not human ankle frames; left/right_knee sites are actual knee joint centers.
left/right_contact are nominal local bottom markers: they rotate with the wheel and are NOT rolling contact points or reliable ground clearance. Compute clearance from collision geometry instead.

Official MJCF and Isaac USD share link offsets and joint axes, but are not numerically identical dynamics models. MJCF base includes fixed IMU mass; wheel collision axial width is 0.010m versus 0.050m in USD, and lateral collision offsets are +/-0.008m versus +/-0.00707m.
Official MJCF wheel motor ctrlrange is +/-40Nm, while the imported USD drive maxForce is 80. Other collision primitives also differ; no cross-engine contact or actuator equivalence is implied.
Mink IK playback does not validate contact forces, balance, jump actuation, self-collision avoidance, or dynamic feasibility. No Isaac assets or runtime are changed.

validation.note: Geometric/FK checks only. Contacts include margin contacts and do not prove dynamically feasible balance or jumping.
